notes: This contract pins one bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 Dimension-table cross-field rule: when a dimension has no named Input data type, its Input data type description must contain non-NA text. Table 14 describes that state as an NA Input data type when no suitable named type exists. The official DIF/FDD mapping represents the column as an inputDataTypes sequence; the supplied official extension uses an empty sequence, and Umbra also retains the existing explicit dataType=NA marker path. The preflight does not decide whether a suitable named type exists, whether text is unambiguous, or require a description to be NA when named types are present. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
